description: Soil test rating bands for confirmed soil markers. Every figure carries a source with verified true/false; a band set whose source is not verified must not rate anything (rateMarker returns status unrated). Bands are listed low to high; a band matches when value >= from (> when fromExclusive) and value < to (<= when toInclusive), exactly as the source prints the limits. Rating is arithmetic on the report value, never agronomic advice.

sources.title: Methods Manual: Soil Testing in India, Department of Agriculture & Cooperation, Ministry of Agriculture, Government of India (January 2011), Table 1 Soil Fertility Ratings
Methods Manual: Soil Testing in India, Department of Agriculture & Cooperation (January 2011), Table 6 critical levels of nutrients in soils

Methods Manual: Soil Testing in India, Department of Agriculture & Cooperation (January 2011), unit and plant nutrient conversion annex (after Motsara and Roy 2008, FAO Fertilizer and Plant Nutrition Bulletin 19)
sources.locator: Conversion tables, printed pages 189-190: P to P2O5 2.29, K to K2O 1.20, mg/kg = ppm

sources.title: Soil Survey Manual 2017 (USDA NRCS), Table 3-15 Reaction Class Terms and Their Ranges in pH
Resource Management, Soil, Soil Rating Chart, TNAU Agritech Portal (c) TNAU 2016, total soluble salts table
sources.locator: Total soluble salts (electrical conductivity): below 1 normal, 1-2 critical for germination, 2-4 critical for growth of sensitive crops, above 4 injurious to most crops

sources.title: Convention 1 mg/kg = 2.24 kg/ha (about 2.24 million kg of soil per hectare, 15 cm at bulk density about 1.5); seen only in secondary and vendor pages, not in a primary Indian manual
sources.locator: Not verified. The DAC manual itself uses about 2 million kg/ha for the surface 0-22 cm, which gives a different factor

conversions.note: Printed as organic C x 1.724 = organic matter and organic matter x 0.580 = organic C (1/1.724 = 0.58). Used only by rateMarkerAssumed, never by rateMarker.
Not used. Macronutrient values reported in mg/kg stay unit_mismatch until a primary source and the soil depth and bulk density are confirmed.

profiles.label: Soil pH
profiles.rejectNote: pH measured in a salt solution reads lower than pH in water; these classes are for pH in water, so no rating is given.

bands.label: strongly_acidic
bands.note: Ultra acid to strongly acid, 5.5 and below

bands.label: strongly_alkaline
bands.note: Strongly and very strongly alkaline, 8.5 and above

profiles.limitations: The source prints classes to one decimal (5.5 then 5.6); a value between them is placed in the lower class because each class starts at the next printed lower limit. The DAC soil testing manual Table 14 lists slightly acid 6.6-6.9, neutral 7.0 and moderately alkaline 7.1-8.5, which gives no usable neutral band; it was read and not used.

profiles.label: Electrical conductivity
profiles.assumeNote: The source does not state the extract; the report's soil to water ratio is shown separately and is not corrected.

bands.label: critical
bands.note: 2 to 4, critical for growth of sensitive crops

profiles.limitations: The 2015 Soil Health Card operational guidelines sample card prints normal below 1, medium 1-3, harmful above 3; the two agree only at 1 dS/m. A planning figure of 2 dS/m as injurious was not found in any source read.

profiles.label: Organic carbon
profiles.limitations: Organic matter is not converted to organic carbon and is not rated.

profiles.label: Available nitrogen
profiles.rejectNote: The rating is defined for alkaline permanganate nitrogen; this report states a different method, so no rating is given.
profiles.assumeNote: The report does not state the nitrogen method; the rating is defined for alkaline permanganate nitrogen.
profiles.limitations: Nitrogen without a stated available pool (nitrogen_unspecified) and total nitrogen are never rated.
